lessons: A measurement instrument can be the defect: qwen2.5vl answered 'unparsed' for every image, so no vision verdict from before 2026-11-05 can be trusted.
The image lane is RAM-blocked before it is model-blocked: 2368 MB free refused a render that succeeded at 4679 MB.
A scorecard dimension that is 'unavailable' must never be averaged in as a pass; and a dimension that is 'not_applicable' is not a gap.
Set consistency compares images inside a scenario, never across scenarios.
Whole-image pHash/SSIM is the wrong instrument for a lifestyle scene against a packshot.

FLUX 3 mi2i reference conditioning does not preserve product identity on this box: ssim 0.01-0.32, phash 26-28 vs the reference. Identity must come from a composite, not from conditioning (measured 2026-11-05, re-scored artifacts).
GitHub search rate-limits at 10 req/min unauthenticated; a rate-limited sweep must be reported as a transport failure, never as "no results".
The competitor gap that matters most is identity: every competitor that does product photography preserves the product; our conditioning path does not, and we now measure that.

A registry that says "installed" while the weights are gone is worse than a missing lane: it fails at call time, after the operator has planned around it. provider-suite now says weights_missing for qwen_image_edit.
Disk, not GPU, is currently the binding constraint for the identity fix: 9.5 GB free against roughly 12 GB of edit weights.
A style file that grows by appending overrides will eventually define the same selector 4 times; the fix is a canonical layer with attribute-selector specificity, not another override at the bottom.
Flex centering a block taller than its container clips the START of the content: on a phone the greeting was pushed above the scroll origin. Top-align and let it scroll.
A contrast measurement must composite the alpha chain; reading a raw rgba() reported a 5% white card over a dark scene as near-white and produced a false 1.45:1.
document.fonts.check() is false for a declared-but-unfetched face under font-display: swap; use document.fonts.load() before asserting a font is available.
OCR is a gate, not a guarantee: cleaning then RE-detecting is what turns "the model probably drew text" into "the delivered file has zero text boxes".
A composite proves identity only if the check compares product pixels: an unmasked crop reported a correct composite as drifted.
The GPU lane is RAM-gated at 4096 MB and the box sat at 3830 MB after two renders; a ComfyUI restart is the routine fix.
An A+ page can pass every mechanical QA check and still not be shippable: repeated tile imagery and a copy/asset mismatch are quality defects no contrast gate catches.
A deterministic background key is fine for a tile and not good enough for a hero: it left a ghost patch of backdrop in the 970x600 header.
A design needs its logo as an asset, not as a string: without it every page falls back to the brand name set in serif, which reads as a floating label rather than a mark.
There is no global egress hook: the Amazon boundary is seven per-site checks over at least 44 caller-supplied URLs. A boundary that depends on each call site remembering is not a control.

A revert is a write. Measured 2026-11-06: autonomy cycle 35 failed and restored the bytes of its declared write_paths, which DELETED tools/egress_guard.py - a file already committed at HEAD. A rollback must restore tracked bytes with 'git checkout --', never by writing a captured 'absent' state, or a failed cycle silently destroys committed work.

A path allowlist without a host check is not an allowlist: 'https://attacker.test/v3/merchant/amazon/products/task_post' passed classify_endpoint because only parsed.path was read. Check the host first, then the path.

Validating an SSRF field at one end is half a fix: callback_url must be refused at submit (so the caller gets a 422 and no job is created) and again at the transport (so a job row written before the check cannot deliver).
ordering_note: Order: T0 incidents, then the automation gate A9-A17, then these measured performance units. They are queued with numbers so that when the gate opens the fix is mechanical, not exploratory.
